news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹32.93 (up from ₹28.80 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹6.62t (flat on FY 2025). Net income: ₹414.2b (up 14% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 6.3% (up from 5.5% in FY 2025). Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 4.0%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 2.3%. Revenue is forecast to grow 3.3% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 6.4% growth forecast for the Oil and Gas industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 2% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 21% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

Shri Satyan Kumar is appointed as Director (Strategy & Corporate Affairs) with effect from May 27, 2026 till the date of his superannuation, i.e. November 30, 2028, or until further orders, whichever is earlier. Shri Satyan Kumar is a seasoned energy sector professional with over 36 years of extensive experience across the oil and gas value chain, including upstream operations, midstream, petrochemicals, corporate strategy, and renewable energy. news.title: ONGC: Future Cash Flows Will Reflect Balanced Execution And Commodity Pricing Risks

Analyst Commentary Recent Street research around the broader energy and cyclical complex, including work on other sectors such as semiconductors, gives some context for how analysts are thinking about valuation, execution risk, and growth when they update targets like the one for Oil and Natural Gas.

news.title: Dividend increased to ₹6.25
news.body: Dividend of ₹6.25 is 25% higher than last year. Ex-date: 18th February 2026 Payment date: 14th March 2026 Dividend yield will be 5.0%, which is higher than the industry average of 1.8%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is well covered by both earnings (45% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (32% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 8.2% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 17% over the next 2 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹7.96 (up from ₹6.85 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.71t (up 2.8% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹100.2b (up 16% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 5.9% (up from 5.2% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 76%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 23%. Revenue is forecast to grow 2.2% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 5.5% growth forecast for the Oil and Gas industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 4% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 20% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited Approves Second Interim Dividend for the Financial Year 2025-26
news.body: The Board of Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited has approved second interim dividend of 125% i.e. INR 6.25 on each equity share of INR 5 for the Financial Year 2025-26. The total payout on this account will be INR 7,8630 million. The Record date for distribution of dividend has been fixed for 18th February 2026 which has been intimated to the stock exchanges. This is in addition to first interim dividend of INR 6.00 per share (120%) declared earlier in November,2025.

Analyst Commentary Recent Street research on comparable industrial and automotive exposed names in the semiconductor space gives a sense of how bullish analysts are thinking about companies tied to long cycle capital spending and electrification themes, which are also key narratives for many oil and natural gas businesses transitioning their portfolios.
